music_profile.sound_description: A lively folk vocal call-and-response led by elder women, accompanied by rhythmic hand clapping and occasional light percussion, creating an energetic and communal sound.
music_profile.vocal_style: Lead woman recites boli; circle repeats in response

basic_steps: Form a circle with other women
Listen to lead woman reciting boli
Move with grace and flexibility within the circle
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning clapping rhythm and call-and-response boliyan
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic clapping; no fixed meter documented

Tested camera/split-screen delivery; AR remains an optional future adapter
